title: Editing a title never starts playback, and every part of it can be clicked with the Select tool
goal: After inserting a title page and typing its words, pressing Command Return (or Escape, or clicking away) just finishes the text: nothing plays. The person is back on the Select tool with the whole title held still at its fully arrived frame, so they can click the subtitle, the accent, the background or any other part and edit it directly. Replay happens only when they ask for it.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-12): "When i add a title page it defaults to editing the title text. when i type something and press cmd enter, it starts playing. it should not. also it's pretty difficult to edit the other things on the page because of the playing. i expect to be in the v tool and click the other things".

From code reading (not run): committing a text edit inside a title calls replayTitleAfterTyping (EditorState+Text.swift:325), which after 450 ms calls replayTitle (EditorState+TitleRestyle.swift:210-229): pause, scrub to the title's inMS, set a stop and play the in. So the playhead lands on the title's first frame where parts have not arrived, which is also why parts are hard to click. Restyle knobs may also replay (EditorState+TitleRestyle.swift:83 'if replaying { replayTitle(id) }'); audit every caller of replayTitle. Title parts are children of a title group; check how a click resolves inside it (it likely picks the group first). This reverses the 'typing relays out and replays' item of title-tiles-play-and-a-few-knobs-restyle-a-title (done) by the user's word; the Library tiles still play on hover.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults: insert a title page, type, press Command Return; record what plays and where the playhead goes; then try to click the subtitle and the accent and record what gets picked

Finishing a text edit inside a title (Command Return, Escape, a click elsewhere) never plays or scrubs the document; the automatic replay after typing (replayTitleAfterTyping, EditorState+TitleRestyle.swift:222, called from EditorState+Text.swift:325) is removed; Replay Title stays on the Title section's Replay button, the right-click menu and the Clip menu
Inserting a title parks the playhead at the title's held moment (every part arrived), not its first frame, so all parts are visible and clickable; it may still open the headline for typing as today

After the text edit ends the Select tool is in hand and a single click on any visible part of a title (headline, subtitle, kicker, accent, backing shape, background) picks that part directly, showing its own Part section; clicking the title's empty background picks the title as a whole; Escape steps from a part up to the whole title; double click on a text part edits its words

Playing never starts by itself anywhere while the person is editing a title (typing, restyling with Theme, Font pair, Energy, Intensity, Background, or changing a part's In/Hold/Out); each of those shows the result at the held frame, and the Part section's Replay plays just that part when asked
The Title restyle knobs still update the title live

A walk inserts a title page, types a headline, presses Command Return, checks nothing is playing and the playhead did not move, clicks the subtitle and checks it is picked, edits it, clicks the accent and checks it is picked
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced at Next defaults (Keynote Clean on V2, typed, Cmd-Return): expectTimeline read 'playing at 1.0, playhead 951ms' 0.7 s after Cmd-Return, and nothing was picked (selected nil): starting to type drops the pick and the commit never gave it back, and the replay scrubbed to the title's first frame, where the subtitle had not arrived. Insert already parked the playhead at the held moment (1850 ms for Stacked Stagger); a click on any part from the top level picked the Title Page group.

Adversarial review before building: a Premiere user clicks a layer of a graphic in the Program monitor and gets that layer, so a title is see-through to a click. Risk: then nothing on the canvas picks the whole title to drag (a title page's Background covers the frame). Answer: Escape steps up to the whole title, and a title held whole stays whole under the next click, so it drags as one; Shift-click from the top level adds whole titles; a right-click on a title you are not inside opens the whole title's menu (Animate In etc., which motion-blur-on-a-fast-slide-walk relies on).

Shipped: core PhotonzDocument.titlePartTarget (LayerGrouping.swift), used by selectionTarget/descendTarget with a new holding: param, extendTarget adds whole titles; titlePartArrival + drawn(atTimeMS:onlyMoving:inTitle:) (TitleDesign.swift) for the Part Replay that plays just that part with the rest held still. App: replayTitleAfterTyping removed; commit and Escape-cancel of a title's words keep that part picked with the title as context and call holdTitleStill (pause, park on the held moment only if the playhead is before it or past the title); restyleTitleInHand never replays (Energy and part In/Out included); Part section Replay -> replayTitlePart; canvas right-click on a title not entered aims at the title. Tests: TitlePartClickTests (15). Walk: editing-a-title-never-plays-walk (new, no flags, pointer clicks).

Acceptance note: 'the playhead did not move' holds (1850 ms before and after Cmd-Return in the walk). Escape on an open title text field cancels the draft (as before) and now leaves that part picked without playing. Replay Title stays on the title clip's timeline right-click and the Clip menu; the canvas right-click never had it.

Walks: all 43 title walks run; a-part-in-a-title-rows (double click into a held title) fixed in core; title-presets-library-shelf-walk needed two Escapes before its tile double click because a layer now stays picked, which exposed a real older bug filed as double-clicking-a-library-title-tile-inserts-it (p2, reproduced). motion-blur-on-a-fast-slide-walk fixed by the right-click rule. title-knobs-restyle-walk note updated. Scripts/test.sh: 12753 tests passed.

Rough dispositions: audit rough lines 2-4 (Escape-then-click keeps the whole title, Replay Title not on the canvas menu, moving backgrounds held during a part replay) are judgement calls for the user to react to on the audit, not filed; line 5 filed as double-clicking-a-library-title-tile-inserts-it.

Finishing a title's words (Cmd-Return, Escape, click away) never plays: the part stays picked inside the title, held at the moment every part has arrived. Restyle knobs never replay; the Part section's Replay plays just that part with the rest held still. One Select-tool click picks any part of a title (core titlePartTarget), Escape steps up to the whole title, right-click on a title not entered opens the whole title's menu. Verified: reproduced first (playing at 1.0 after Cmd-Return), TitlePartClickTests (15), Scripts/test.sh 12753 passed, editing-a-title-never-plays-walk ok at Next defaults with pointer clicks, all 43 title walks ok after fixes. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-12-title-editing-never-plays.json. Follow-up: double-clicking-a-library-title-tile-inserts-it.
